preview.label: Preview
preview.engineDown: The video engine (libobs) did not start. Check the log.

tracking.label: Face tracking
tracking.cameraDenied: No permission to use the camera. Check Windows Settings → Privacy → Camera.
tracking.cameraBusy: The camera is being used by another program (Zoom, Teams, the Camera app…). Close it and try again.

errors.engine_not_running: The video engine is not running.

tooltips.loadAvatar: 3D avatars in VRM format (version 0.x or 1.0). Keep them in the recursos\avatares folder. Don’t have one? Create it for free with VRoid Studio.
tooltips.tracking: Uses your webcam so the avatar copies your head, eyes and mouth. Everything is processed on your device: the video never leaves your computer.
tooltips.fps: How many times per second your face is analyzed. Above 25 looks smooth; if it drops, add more light in front of you.
tooltips.values: What the camera measures, from 0 to 1. Mouth: 0 = closed, 1 = wide open. Eyes: 0 = open, 1 = closed. Use it to tune blinking and the mouth (user guide, section 7).
tooltips.lipsync: Will move the avatar’s mouth with your voice, using the microphone. Coming soon.
tooltips.expression: Shortcut {shortcut}: works even when avat-os is not in the foreground. Press it again to go back to neutral. Some avatars block blinking or the mouth with certain expressions.
tooltips.neutral: Clears the active expression and returns to the normal face.
tooltips.background: Background behind the avatar. It is transparent for now; soon you will be able to use a color or an image (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF; ideally 1920×1080).
tooltips.comingSoon: Still under construction: coming in a future version.
